widgets_values:
IRON PULSE — ONE-CANVAS BLOCKBUSTER WORKFLOW

1) This is a ComfyUI UI workflow (.json), not an API graph. Open it with Workflow → Open.
2) All story, image, motion, voice, music and SFX prompts are editable ComfyUI text nodes.
3) Choose your own model in the loader nodes. This file does not download or select models.
4) The connected IMAGE GENERATOR is a standard core-node example. It uses the ACTIVE IMAGE PROMPT node; copy any Sxx prompt from the library into it.
5) Video and audio areas are model-agnostic handoff slots. Add the I2V/TTS/music/SFX nodes you have installed and connect the adjacent STRING prompts.
6) Queue only the generation branch you intend to run. Review every result before moving to the next stage.

No missing-model error is a workflow-design error: the checkpoint dropdown will remain empty until you install/select a compatible model.
